staging.about: EX-CH03-S04 (canon): the quake knocked the garden spur label crooked; Kai wants to straighten it and Amara asks him to leave the evidence visible until the test is saved (S04 -> S05). It is straight from EX-CH03-S06 on.
EX-CH03-S04 on: the captive clamp seated on the garden spur feedthrough stays (doc 09: props accumulate).
EX-CH03-S05 (canon): "When the warning clears, Amara leaves the independent gauge on its hook." It stays there (doc 24 montage: in August she shows Kai how she reads it).

EX-CH06 power room (doc 24 §2.6, §2.9): the guide light leaves the protected supply at the junction box Kai taped in December (CH05 -> CH06 join) and runs low along the aisle wall to the Commons door; the protected-bus test panel with camera feeder F2 (A-42) stands by that door; two decorative wall floods light the aisle until the eclipse plan sheds them. Installed hardware: it stays after Chapter 6.

From EX-CH06-S01 the scratched hand light lives in its clip in the locker over the bench (Kai 'remembers the locker without needing its label'); he takes it in S01 and puts it back in S11 (S11 -> S12 join).

The eclipse planning stations of EX-CH06-S01..S05 and S10..S11: the allocation board above the guide line (five segment cards from S01, the P-11 accepted plan from S04), a camera repeater on a desk in the power bay (dark until the camera is protected; no signal when F2 trips in S10; restored in S11) and Kai's dated personal log. The eclipse plan dims the practicals in S10-S11 so the amber guide line is the only warm light (doc 24 §2.6).

staging.about: EX-CH06 S01 -> S02 join: Kai takes the scratched hand light from its locker and clips it where both hands stay free; it returns to its clip during S11 (S11 -> S12 join), so the locker shows it again afterwards.
Doc 24 §5.2 D11: when the player chose Rafi in S01, Rafi stands at Kai's shoulder at the F2 panel and Amara keeps the channel from the board (without a recorded choice, or for Amara, the reverse).

Ferreira's corridor watch (EX-CH05-S01 canon: she takes the corridor watch instead of a chair): her locker shelf, where in S02 she leaves the sealed document sleeve from her relief cargo unopened (doc 24 2.9 S02 -> S03: on 14 Dec she brings it to the table), a standing watch desk on the aisle wall by the Commons door, her watch log (EX-CH05-S02: she checks a label, writes the time, waits for the next reading; her round passes the annex hatch N.R., doc 24 3.5 F11) and, from S06 until she brings it back to the table in S11, her mug (EX-CH05-S06 canon: 'Ferreira takes her mug back to the watch station').

EX-CH05-S02 (doc 22 7.1 clue 3): the replacement relay controller sits in its sealed crate in the corridor; Rafi reads its serial against the received manifest clipped to the lid, Kai checks that its service diagram is saved locally, and the facts go on the inventory board: one spare, stored once (in the Commons spare locker), needing a compatible housing, an isolation procedure and a crew who know where it is. The spare does not fix anything by arriving.

staging.about: EX-CH05-S08 'Maintenance console and isolated garden spur' (doc 22 7.3; 08 P-10): two symptoms, two causes, two measurements. The maintenance console in the power bay shows the solar panel trend below its reference (dust: income 8 -> 6 until cleaned) with the scheduled cleaning card and kit; the isolated garden spur's own pressure trace shows a slow fall on that branch only, with the patch kit at the spur's safe side; the living enclosure stays closed. Neither protective upgrade is owned yet. Ferreira's mug is on the watch desk.

staging.about: EX-CH07-S11 'Make the Road Hear Us' (March to 7 April): EN_Fabrication in the power bay and the air bay. The bench faces the walkway: the spare controller from December in its cradle and its case open beside the bench with Kai's compatibility note still clipped inside the lid (S10 -> S11), the spare battery, the connector tray (one wrong connector), the echo unit and the isolation checklist Ferreira signs. The surveyed-route simulator (the real LOLA corridor) waits with its three repeater pins parked: every neighbouring link must clear the terrain, and a desk plan is not field proof. Installed equipment: it stays after the chapter.
